description: Two dated notes that disagree. Both are evidence: the later one revises the earlier one.

fragments.title: Morning runs work
fragments.body: Three weeks of running before work: I'm calmer at my desk and sleep better. Keep the 6:30 alarm.

fragments.title: Stopped the early runs
fragments.body: By mid-afternoon I was wrecked every day. Running after work instead; the day holds together better.

fragments.title: 6 am jogging group?
fragments.body: A neighbour asked if I want to join the park jogging crew that meets at six before work.
